method: Partition retained linker-map contributions using their archive member and Bloaty compile-unit source paths. All retained TFLM members have an unambiguous core/operator category in these images. Byte sizes remain linker-map sizes, including read-only data.

definitions.tflm_core_bytes: TFLM interpreter, allocation/planning, context, schema/type support; excludes dedicated logging objects and source paths under kernels/.
definitions.tflm_operator_bytes: TFLM operator implementations, CMSIS-NN integration wrappers, reference paths and shared utilities under tensorflow/lite/**/kernels/.
definitions.cmsis_nn_bytes: Linked CMSIS-NN implementation objects, including retained numeric variants.
definitions.selected_resolver_bytes: Separately emitted selected operator registration and resolver methods/vtable.
definitions.total_bytes: Core + TFLM operators + CMSIS-NN + selected resolver, excluding the embedded model and previously separated overhead.
